auctionDebt().details: It can only auction debt that has been popped from the debt queue and is not already being auctioned

auctionSurplus().details: It can only auction surplus if `surplusIsTransferred` is set to falseIt can only auction surplus if `surplusDelay` seconds have elapsed since the last surplus auction/transfer was triggeredIt can only auction surplus if enough surplus remains in the buffer and if there is no more debt left to settle

popDebtFromQueue(uint256).details: A debtBlock can be popped from the queue after `popDebtDelay` seconds have passed since creation

params._debtBlockTimestamp: Timestamp of the block of debt that should be popped out

pushDebtToQueue(uint256).details: Usually called by the `LiquidationEngine` when a SAFE is liquidatedDebt is locked in a queue to give the system enough time to auction collateral         and gather surplus

settleDebt(uint256).details: It can only destroy debt that is not locked in the queue and also not in a debt auction (`unqueuedUnauctionedDebt`)

params._rad: Amount of coins & debt to destroy [rad]

transferExtraSurplus().details: It can only transfer surplus if `surplusIsTransferred` is set to trueIt can only transfer surplus if `surplusDelay` seconds have elapsed since the last surplus auction/transfer was triggeredIt can only transfer surplus if enough surplus remains in the buffer and if there is no more debt left to settle

transferPostSettlementSurplus().details: Transfer any remaining surplus after `disableCooldown` seconds have passed since disabling the contract

unqueuedUnauctionedDebt().details: The difference between the debt in the SAFEEngine and the debt in the debtQueue and on auction

devdoc.title: AccountingEngine

AccEng_DebtAuctionDisabled().notice: Throws when trying to auction debt when it is disabled

AccEng_InsufficientDebt().notice: Throws when trying to settle debt when there is not enough debt left to settle

AccEng_InsufficientSurplus().notice: Throws when trying to auction / transfer surplus when there is not enough surplus

AccEng_NullAmount().notice: Throws when trying to push / pop / auction a null amount of debt / surplus

AccEng_NullSurplusReceiver().notice: Throws when trying to transfer surplus to a null address

AccEng_PopDebtCooldown().notice: Throws when trying to pop debt before the cooldown has passed

AccEng_PostSettlementCooldown().notice: Throws when trying to transfer post-settlement surplus before the disable cooldown has passed

AccEng_SurplusAuctionDisabled().notice: Throws when trying to auction surplus when it is disabled

AccEng_SurplusCooldown().notice: Throws when trying to auction / transfer surplus before the cooldown has passed

AccEng_SurplusTransferDisabled().notice: Throws when trying to transfer surplus when it is disabled

AlreadyAuthorized().notice: Throws if the account is already authorized on `addAuthorization`

ContractIsDisabled().notice: Throws when trying to call a `whenEnabled` method when the contract is disabled

ContractIsEnabled().notice: Throws when trying to call a `whenDisabled` method when the contract is enabled

NonDisableable().notice: Throws when trying to disable a contract that cannot be disabled

NotAuthorized().notice: Throws if the account is not authorized on `removeAuthorization`

Unauthorized().notice: Throws if the account is not authorized and tries to call an `onlyAuthorized` method

Meant to be a backup in case GlobalSettlement.processSAFE         has a bug, governance doesn't have power over the system and there's still surplus left in the AccountingEngine         which then blocks GlobalSettlement.setOutstandingCoinSupply.
